+"""Camera-guided ALOHA-AgileX trajectory for RoboTwin place_mouse_pad.
+
+Run one phase at a time against the single live episode. Each phase takes a
+fresh observation and uses measured end-effector poses for the idle arm.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/runs')
+CAMERAS = ('head_camera', 'front_camera', 'left_camera', 'right_camera',
+           'observer_camera', 'world_camera1')
+# Tool local +X points down; local +Y is the intended pinch direction.
+DOWN_Q = np.array([np.sqrt(0.5), 0., np.sqrt(0.5), 0.])
+
+
+def tcp_to_ee(tcp, qwxyz):
+    q = np.asarray(qwxyz, float)
+    axis = Rotation.from_quat([q[1], q[2], q[3], q[0]]).apply([1., 0., 0.])
+    return np.asarray(tcp, float) - 0.12 * axis
+
+
+def save_result(result, label):
+    d = OUT / label
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, img in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(img).save(d / f'{cam}.png')
+    print(json.dumps({k: result.meta.get(k) for k in
+                      ('done', 'reason', 'time_left_s', 'plan', 'clipped')}, default=str))
+    p = result.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now')
+    if p is not None:
+        print('ee', np.round(p[14:28], 4).tolist())
+        print('tcp', np.round(p[56:70], 4).tolist())
+        print('gripper measured', round(p[36], 4), round(p[43], 4))
+
+
+def move_left(robot, label, tcp, q=DOWN_Q, grip=1.0):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=('head_camera',), video='none')
+    p = obs.meta['proprio']['now']
+    row = np.asarray(p[14:22] + p[21:28] + [p[29]], float)
+    # p[14:21] = left pose, p[21:28] = right pose.
+    row = np.asarray(p[14:21] + [p[28]] + p[21:28] + [p[29]], float)
+    row[:3] = tcp_to_ee(tcp, q)
+    row[3:7] = q
+    row[7] = grip
+    result = robot.submit('ee_pose', row, cameras=CAMERAS, video='none',
+                          note=label)
+    save_result(result, label)
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('phase', choices=('pregrasp', 'descend', 'close',
+                                          'lift', 'carry', 'place', 'release',
+                                          'retreat', 'observe'))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    if args.phase == 'observe':
+        save_result(robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, video='none'), 'observe')
+        return
+    # These are TCP targets in world metres. Updated after each camera check.
+    targets = {
+        'pregrasp': ([-0.111, -0.056, 0.900], 1.0),
+        'descend': ([-0.111, -0.056, 0.784], 1.0),
+        'close': ([-0.111, -0.056, 0.784], 0.0),
+        'lift': ([-0.111, -0.056, 0.900], 0.0),
+        'carry': ([-0.073, -0.188, 0.900], 0.0),
+        'place': ([-0.073, -0.188, 0.790], 0.0),
+        'release': ([-0.073, -0.188, 0.790], 1.0),
+        'retreat': ([-0.073, -0.188, 0.900], 1.0),
+    }
+    tcp, grip = targets[args.phase]
+    move_left(robot, args.phase, tcp, grip=grip)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch";
